findings.situation: A filer whose Form W-2 shows more than four box 12 or box 14 items fills a second W-2 Record for the same W-2, and when asked this question for that record truthfully enters the NYC withholding from the W-2 again, so it is counted twice.
findings.source_text: ny_it2 p. 2: "If your federal Form W-2 shows more than four items in box 12 or box 14, complete an additional W-2 Record. Fill in boxes a, b, and c with the same information as on the first W-2 Record for the same federal Form W-2. Then enter the additional items in box 12 or box 14." Question: "For this Form W-2 (Form IT-2, W-2 record) — Form W-2 box 19, local income tax withheld for New York City (0 if none)"
findings.why: The question ties the answer to the federal W-2 ("For this Form W-2") and not to the IT-2 record, and neither it nor its help says a continuation record must show 0. A truthful filer would repeat the box 19 NYC amount on the continuation record, and that amount then flows twice into the NYC withholding total on IT-201, line 73.

findings.situation: A filer whose federal Form W-2 shows more than four box 12 or box 14 items needs a second W-2 Record for the same W-2, and if asked this question again for that record would truthfully re-enter the same box 17 New York withholding, so it is counted twice.
findings.source_text: ny_it2 p. 2: "If your federal Form W-2 shows more than four items in box 12 or box 14, complete an additional W-2 Record. Fill in boxes a, b, and c with the same information as on the first W-2 Record for the same federal Form W-2. Then enter the additional items in box 12 or box 14."
findings.why: The question asks "New York State income tax withheld on this Form W-2" for each W-2 Record. A continuation record should carry only boxes a, b, c and the extra box 12/14 items, not box 17a again. Line 17a amounts are totaled to IT-201 line 72, so repeating the withholding double-counts it.

findings.situation: For a record marked Corrected (W-2c), the federal Form W-2c shows both a 'previously reported' and a 'correct information' amount for state income tax withheld, and the question does not say which one to enter.
findings.source_text: ny_it2 p. 2: "Corrected (W-2c) box – Mark an X in this box if the W-2 Record is for a federal Form W-2c ... Enter the corrected information from the W-2c"
findings.why: The question's "box 17 ... where box 15 shows NY" fits either column on a W-2c. The text requires the corrected figure, so a filer who enters the previously reported amount gives a different value.
